chat.code_void: Too many wrong codes. Start binding again in Persona to get a new code.
chat.hub_error: Didn't reach Persona: something went wrong on the hub. Send it again in a bit.
chat.not_paired: This robot isn't paired yet. In Persona, open Settings › Channels › WeCom, bind it, and send the code shown there to this chat.
chat.paired: Paired. What you send here now goes to Persona.
chat.stranger: This robot only works for the person who paired it.
chat.wrong_code: That code is wrong. Check the code shown in Persona.
guide.bind: Enter the robot's BotID and Secret here, then send the pairing code to the robot in a one-to-one chat.
guide.create_robot: In the WeCom admin console, create a smart robot (智能机器人) and choose API mode.
guide.long_connection: Under the API settings, choose the long connection, and get the robot's BotID and Secret.
login.creds_hint: In the WeCom admin console, create a smart robot in API mode, choose the long connection as the connection method, and copy its BotID and Secret. Only one program can hold a robot's long connection at a time.
login.creds_missing: Enter both the BotID and the Secret
login.pair_expired: The pairing code expired. Start binding again
login.pair_hint: In WeCom, send this code to the robot in a one-to-one chat within 10 minutes. Only the person who sends it can use the robot.
wecom.kicked: Another program connected to this robot and took it over. Persona tries again in 30 minutes; stop the other program, or bind again to take it back now.
wecom.not_paired: Not paired yet: bind again and send the code to the robot in WeCom
